# settings

Settings dialog and the prefs it edits.

Read first: `docs/features/settings/spec.md`, `docs/features/settings/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/rail-user-owned-manual-order-default` — The rail has two sort modes: manual, the default, keeps a user-owned pinned-then-positional order; attention is the old needs-input-first sort, kept as a mode. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: rail, settings) → `docs/adr/rail-user-owned-manual-order-default.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-pref-enum-follow-not-nullable` — The theme pref is an enum with a follow default, not a nullable; the daemon validates a pattern and treats the value as opaque, the client owns the registry. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, settings) → `docs/adr/theme-pref-enum-follow-not-nullable.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-pref-follows-claude-until-picked` — A Settings dialog offers Follow Claude Code, Instrument, Dark and Light as a theme pref; until the user picks, the dashboard follows Claude Code's family. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, settings) → `docs/adr/theme-pref-follows-claude-until-picked.md`
- `kb:adr/update-check-pref-governs-checking-only` — One boolean pref, default on, governs only whether the daemon checks for a newer release; applying is always explicit via a button or the update flag. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update, settings) → `docs/adr/update-check-pref-governs-checking-only.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-one-selectable-model-window` — The wire carries every model-scoped weekly window; the masthead shows one, chosen by a selector and persisted as a preference with a default model. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: usage, settings) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-one-selectable-model-window.md`
